{{Quote|I had no idea he'd respond this brutally&mdash;he must want the ''Brentaal Star's'' passenger pretty badly. Maybe he just hates me.|Captain Revinal Orzik of the ''Black Talon'', to Grand Moff Kilran's agents|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Revinal Orzik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the ''[[Black Talon]]'', a [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]], in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{GameDS}}
Near the end of the Cold War, Orzik disobeyed a direct order from [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]]. Kilran then dispatched a strike team to discipline Orzik for disobeying orders. When Kilran's agents entered his ship, he refused to comply with Moff's orders and was killed for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Revinal Orzik was featured in a development diary released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="VD3">{{TORweb|url=news/article/20090717_002|text=The Voice of the Old Republic|nolive=1}}</ref>

Players have the two options: they can kill Orzik for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark alignment points]] or spare him for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light alignment points]]. If he is killed, Republic droids board the Imperial ship. Also, several crew members become terrified and are executed by the new commanding officer Lieutenant [[Sylas]]; by the time the player(s) returns from the ''Brentaal Star'', every personnel in the bridge except for [[NR-02]] are found dead. If Orzik is spared, Republic humans instead attack the ''Black Talon''. When the player(s) prove to be successful in their mission, Orzik repents on his actions.
